attempts.text: [{"name": "last_order_copurchase", "idea": "Item-to-item affinity between the candidate and the products of the user's latest order: the mean over those products of P(candidate in an order | product in that order) over the last 7 days, and its log lift over the candidate's base order rate.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), lo AS (SELECT user_id, order_id FROM (SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.ts DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rk FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id) x WHERE rk = 1), lq AS (SELECT DISTINCT lo.user_id, l.product_id AS q FROM lines l JOIN lo ON l.order_id = lo.order_id), nq AS (SELECT user_id, count(*) AS n_q FROM lq GROUP BY user_id), l7 AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY), nt AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_o FROM l7), pn AS (SELECT product_id, count(*) AS n_p FROM l7 GROUP BY product_id), qa AS (SELECT order_id, product_id FROM l7 WHERE product_id IN (SELECT q FROM lq)), pb AS (SELECT order_id, product_id FROM l7 WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand)), co AS (SELECT qa.product_id AS q, pb.product_id AS p, count(*) AS n_qp FROM qa JOIN pb ON qa.order_id = pb.order_id AND qa.product_id <> pb.product_id GROUP BY qa.product_id, pb.product_id), s AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, sum(co.n_qp * 1.0 / pq.n_p) AS s_cond FROM cand c JOIN lq ON lq.user_id = c.user_id JOIN co ON co.q = lq.q AND co.p = c.product_id JOIN pn pq ON pq.product_id = lq.q GROUP BY c.user_id, c.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, COALESCE(s.s_cond, 0.0) / nq.n_q AS ag_co_last_cond, ln((COALESCE(s.s_cond, 0.0) / nq.n_q + 0.001) / (COALESCE(pn.n_p, 0) * 1.0 / nt.n_o + 0.001)) AS ag_co_last_lift FROM cand c JOIN nq ON nq.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.user_id = c.user_id AND s.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN pn ON pn.product_id = c.product_id CROSS JOIN nt"}, {"name": "up_gap_conditioned_share", "idea": "Smoothed share of the user's orders placed after a gap at least as long as the current days since the user's last order that contain the product, matching the situation of the next order (big restock vs top-up).", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), uo AS (SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, epoch(o.ts - lag(o.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.ts, o.order_id)) / 86400.0 AS gap_d FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id), ul AS (SELECT o.user_id, max(o.ts) AS last_ts, count(*) AS n_u FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY o.user_id), qo AS (SELECT uo.user_id, uo.order_id FROM uo JOIN ul ON ul.user_id = uo.user_id WHERE uo.gap_d >= epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ul.last_ts) / 86400.0), nqo AS (SELECT user_id, count(*) AS n_g FROM qo GROUP BY user_id), op AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.product_id FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id), up AS (SELECT op.user_id, op.product_id, count(*) AS n_p, count(qo.order_id) AS k_g FROM op LEFT JOIN qo ON qo.order_id = op.order_id GROUP BY op.user_id, op.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, (up.k_g + 2.0 * up.n_p / ul.n_u) / (COALESCE(nqo.n_g, 0) + 2.0) AS ag_up_gapcond_share FROM cand c JOIN up ON up.user_id = c.user_id AND up.product_id = c.product_id JOIN ul ON ul.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN nqo ON nqo.user_id = c.user_id"}, {"name": "user_parent_category_affinity", "idea": "Coarser category affinity via the parent of the product's category: share of the user's orders with any product of that parent category and days since the user last bought it, covering never-bought candidates.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), pc AS (SELECT product_id, max(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), pp AS (SELECT pc.product_id, COALESCE(cg.parent_id, pc.cat) AS par FROM pc LEFT JOIN categories cg ON cg.id = pc.cat), un AS (SELECT o.user_id, count(*) AS n_u FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY o.user_id), ul AS (SELECT l.user_id, COALESCE(cg.parent_id, l.master_category_id) AS par, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS n_par, max(l.ts) AS last_ts FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id LEFT JOIN categories cg ON cg.id = l.master_category_id WHERE l.master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.user_id, COALESCE(cg.parent_id, l.master_category_id)) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, CASE WHEN pp.par IS NULL OR un.n_u IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(ul.n_par, 0) * 1.0 / un.n_u END AS ag_upar_share, epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ul.last_ts) / 86400.0 AS ag_upar_days FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pp ON pp.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN un ON un.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN ul ON ul.user_id = c.user_id AND ul.par = pp.par"}, {"name": "p_basket_context", "idea": "Order context of the product over the last 28 days: smoothed mean basket size of orders containing it relative to the overall mean (weekly-restock staple vs small-basket item), and the smoothed share of its orders that were top-ups placed within 2 days of the buyer's previous order.", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH ob AS (SELECT order_id, count(DISTINCT product_id) AS nb FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY GROUP BY order_id), og AS (SELECT order_id, epoch(ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id)) / 86400.0 AS gap_d FROM orders), ga AS (SELECT avg(nb) AS m_nb FROM ob), op AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY) SELECT op.product_id, (sum(ob.nb) + 10.0 * ga.m_nb) / (count(*) + 10.0) / ga.m_nb AS ag_p_basket_rel, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE og.gap_d < 2) + 1.0) / (count(og.gap_d) + 10.0) AS ag_p_topup_share FROM op JOIN ob ON ob.order_id = op.order_id JOIN og ON og.order_id = op.order_id CROSS JOIN ga GROUP BY op.product_id, ga.m_nb"}, {"name": "up_last_quantity_rel", "idea": "Quantity the user took of the product in the latest purchase relative to the user's mean per-order quantity of it, since a stock-up delays the next repurchase.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), ul AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, l.order_id, sum(l.quantity) AS q, max(l.ts) AS ts FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY l.user_id, l.product_id, l.order_id), r AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, q, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id ORDER BY ts DESC, order_id DESC) AS rk, avg(q) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id) AS mq, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id) AS n FROM ul) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, r.q * 1.0 / r.mq AS ag_up_lastqty_rel FROM cand c JOIN r ON r.user_id = c.user_id AND r.product_id = c.product_id WHERE r.rk = 1 AND r.n >= 2 AND r.mq > 0"}]
